        This file contains death records from the Bessarabian villages
        of South Russia for the period 1860-1869. (No records are available
        for 1865 or 1866)  This information was compiled by R. Reuben Drefs,
        coordinator and volunteers Jan Stangl, Tom Stangel, Ed Schulz
        and Darlene Drefs from the St. Petersburg Lutheran Evangelical
        archives published by the LDS.  Kischinew data added 20 Jun 1999.
        Edited by Marty McMahon.
